programmes.d: After two chefs are eliminated, the remaining chefs must create a unique dining experience for a large group of well-known chefs that include guest judges Bruce Kalman, Steve Samson, Mette Williams, and Alessio Biagini.
The final two chefs prepare for their final service.
In the Season 17 premiere, Chef Ramsay invites 16 all-stars back to the kitchen to vie for the head chef position at the new Hell's Kitchen restaurant in Las Vegas.
The all-star chefs compete against each other in a bar menu challenge with a valuable prize: immunity from elimination.
The chefs must complete a four-tiered shellfish tower. During the dinner service, Chef Ramsay sends multiple entrees back to the kitchen and temporarily kicks out one of the competing chefs.
The remaining chefs must face off in a game of chance to divvy up their ingredients and create their own unique dishes.
After a shocking change, tension in the dorms is at an all-time high. Then, the chefs are challenged to work in pairs and cook different types of fish on cedar and hickory wood planks.
The remaining chefs are given 30 minutes to create a pizza inspired by an assigned country.
Both teams must replicate six Hell’s Kitchen entrees while kicking chefs out of the kitchen until only one remains. That night, Chef Ramsay holds a special challenge.
The contestants must create a dish using exotic meats including boar, venison and elk that were eaten by early humans.
The remaining contestants compete in a special challenge involving sea creatures.
The remaining contestants must prepare a five-course meal for a private charity event.
The all-stars are given $20 to buy ingredients for restaurant-quality pasta dishes.
The all-stars face three difficult challenges for the coveted black jacket.
The chefs must instruct some famous athletes to make their signature dishes using only verbal instructions. The contestants cook in one kitchen during dinner service.
Families of the four remaining chefs visit. The chefs must base a dish on a secret ingredient hidden in a gift chosen by them.
Chef Ramsay announces that Nick, Michelle, and Benjamin must design and cook a five-course menu.

In this finale episode, the winner of this season is revealed.
Chef Ramsay invites eight previous contestants back to the kitchen to battle against eight rookies for a chance at the Executive Chef position at the Hell's Kitchen Restaurant in Vegas.
Chef Ramsay announces that he is taking his risotto off of the Hell's Kitchen menu, and the contestants are tasked with making their own risotto dish in the hopes of replacing the old one.
The chefs are tasked with serving lunch to a room full of Marines and prepare dishes that represent the air (chicken parmesan), the land (New York strip) and the sea (fish and chips).
The chefs must compete in a sled race for an advantage in the winter soup challenge.
During the challenge, each team is tasked with cooking halibut seven different ways for Michelin star chef David LeFevre.
Chef Ramsay introduces the chefs to a culinary legend known all over the world, Mr. Potato Head. For their challenge, the chefs must create a dish with potato as the key component.
